Loupe's menu. A panel of actions or links that opens under a trigger, with items, headings and dividers.

```jsx
<Menu variant="light">Example</Menu>
<Menu variant="chrome">Example</Menu>
```

Variants: `light`, `chrome`. Sizes: `sm`, `md`, `lg`. States: open.

Labels are sentence case and never end in a full stop. The component emits the real `lp-menu` classes of the app.
